core_strengths: Zero-to-one product design inside complex SaaS domains
Systems-level thinking and platform-wide pattern work
Cross-functional influence with engineering and product leadership
Operational software complexity — finance, ops, workflow tooling
AI-augmented product surfaces and agentic UX
Founding and first-designer roles inside small senior teams
preferred_environments: Direct collaboration with product and engineering leadership
Complex operational SaaS or AI-native surfaces
Mid-stage scale-up or focused enterprise transformation work

work_model_preference.hard_limit: No more than 2 days on-site per week

hard_blockers: Recruiter-fronted roles where the employer is not named
known_frictions: Heavy stakeholder management with low operational ownership
Matrix reporting without clear design leadership
Working inside a SAFe / quarterly-OKR delivery cadence
Generic 'design improvements' scope without a defining operational signal

cv_variants.label: Founding Product Designer
cv_variants.best_for: Series A / Seed roles where you are the first designer

cv_variants.label: Principal Product Designer
cv_variants.best_for: Enterprise IC roles inside complex operational SaaS

cv_variants.label: Lead Product Designer
cv_variants.best_for: Mid-market scale-ups with established design teams

cv_variants.label: Staff Product Designer
cv_variants.best_for: Platform or systems work inside larger orgs

decision_lens: Does this role have a defining operational signal that justifies the move?
Is the company maturity stated, or am I being asked to infer it?
How much of the work is direct design vs stakeholder coordination?
Is the work transformation, modernisation, or feature delivery?
What is the actual ownership shape — sole owner, peer, or one of many?
